title: Cover Picture and Issue Information
content: Cover image: Critically endangered Christmas Island Flying Fox (Pteropus natalis), the island’s last remaining native mammal, photographed on Christmas Island during the island’s first community bat night, held in remembrance of the extinct Christmas Island pipistrelle (Pipistrellus murrayi). Photo by: Kelly Sheldrick
